metadata.title: {name} — The ultra-light SaaS boilerplate
metadata.description: Launch your SaaS in minutes with authentication, database, billing, emails, dark mode and i18n already wired up.

hero.title: Ship your SaaS, not your boilerplate
hero.description: A lean, typed and modular foundation built on managed services. Set it up in under five minutes and spend your time on the product.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.description: Each piece is a managed service behind a small, readable integration.

auth.title: Managed authentication
auth.description: Sign-in, sign-up and sessions handled by Clerk, with private routes protected by default.

database.title: Ultra-light data layer
database.description: Supabase through the official client. Typed tables and Server Actions, no heavy ORM.

billing.title: Billing without tax headaches
billing.description: Lemon Squeezy acts as Merchant of Record, with cryptographically verified webhooks.

emails.title: Transactional emails
emails.description: Templates written in React and delivered with Resend.

i18n.title: Multilingual by default
i18n.description: Locale-based routes and typed dictionaries, rendered on the server.

theme.title: Dark mode included
theme.description: Light, dark and system themes with no flash on load.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.description: Start for free and upgrade when you grow.

cta.title: Ready to launch?
cta.description: Pick a plan and go from idea to production today.

footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js, Clerk, Supabase and Lemon Squeezy.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: This page is only visible to signed-in users.

welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
